versions.changelog:
ai-poster-generator 1.0.0

- Initial release of the AI Poster Generator skill for Craftsman Agent via the OneKey Agent Gateway.
- Generate editable AI posters using advanced image models and customizable design configurations.
- Supports various formats, asset sizes, ratios, and design styles.
- Allows word editing on poster elements such as headline, content, and footer.
- Provides both website and API-based workflows for poster generation and export.
